snippet.title: 能准点下班吗？[Can You Get Off Work on Time?] // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3213770/_/

This is an independent role-playing puzzle game. You will play as a worker who is about to get off work at six o'clock, but encounters a series of workplace troubles that prevent you from getting off work on time. Is it really just a luxury to get off work on time?

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: CDB
📚 Publisher: CDB
📅 Release Date: Sep 28, 2024
🎯 Genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, RPG, Strategy

English language not supported
